packs.name: Draconia Malfoid (uniform)
packs.description: An unofficial, non-commercial fan character, Draconia Malfoid, loosely inspired by Draco Malfoy: a 21-year-old adult woman in a black hooded robe, green-and-silver tie, grey vest and skirt. Not affiliated with Warner Bros. or Wizarding World. A proud, sharp-tongued tsundere, secretly caring. The pictures were made with AI.
packs.credit: Draconia Malfoid (uniform): an unofficial, non-commercial fan character, pictures made with AI (Grok Imagine).
